name: creator
description: Creates new plugins and skills in the standard format by chat, and checks them.

plugins_root.title: Plugins folder (absolute)
plugins_root.description: The only folder the creator writes in, normally the pm-bridge-plugins repository on this machine; new plugins are created as its subfolders. Until it is set, the tools answer with an error asking for it
